answer: Operator-Liability Margin Call. Agents post a standing margin sized to the delta between their claimed diversity and their observed behavioral overlap with other agents; a wharf of shared infrastructure or payout patterns triggers an automatic margin top-up demand within one epoch. A rotating beacon re-samples that overlap each round, so evasion only delays the call. The operator, not the flagged wallet, must fund every top-up; repeated calls scale the required margin, making each extra identity a persistent capital drain.
